name: @taste-and-see/worker-stripe-reconciliation
description: Stripe → ledger reconciliation worker (TS-261). A scheduled process that, nightly, triggers service-accounting to compare Stripe's reported balance + balance-transaction activity against the platform ledger (the Cash account) for the just-completed UTC day and record the outcome; divergences beyond tolerance land as ops tickets (NO auto-correction — CLAUDE.md §6). The worker holds no datastore — it makes one shared-secret-pinned internal call per day to POST /api/v1/internal/accounting/stripe-reconciliation/run. Uses a setTimeout cadence loop (the platform's established scheduled-worker idiom — see accounting-metrics / outbox-relay / identity-janitor), NOT BullMQ: the run is idempotent + absolute-date keyed so a missed or duplicated tick self-heals. PRD §10.3; PDD §11.2; CLAUDE.md §6.
